# conative_azuresql_database_permission (Resource)

Grants or denies one permission to a database principal, on the database or on one schema. The resource manages exactly that one permission; nothing else changes.

The provider never grants with grant option, and destroying the resource revokes exactly this permission without cascading. A permission that was granted with grant option outside Terraform is reported as `GRANT_WITH_GRANT_OPTION`, which shows as a difference and plans a replacement; the revoke then fails until the grant option is removed.

Creating the resource fails if the principal already holds the permission in any state, including the `CONNECT` permission that every new database user receives; import it instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Let an identity read the definitions of every object in the database.
resource "conative_azuresql_database_permission" "reader_view_definition" {
  database   = "orders"
  principal  = "plan-reader"
  state      = "GRANT"
  permission = "VIEW DEFINITION"
}

# Deny reading the data in one schema.
resource "conative_azuresql_database_permission" "deny_sales_select" {
  database   = "orders"
  principal  = "plan-reader"
  state      = "DENY"
  permission = "SELECT"
  schema     = "sales"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database` (String) Database name. Changing it replaces the permission.
- `permission` (String) The permission, in upper case, for example `VIEW DEFINITION` or `SELECT`. It must be valid for the database, or for a schema when `schema` is set. Changing it replaces the permission.
- `principal` (String) Name of the database principal, a user or a role. Changing it replaces the permission.
- `state` (String) `GRANT` or `DENY`. When read from the database it can also be `GRANT_WITH_GRANT_OPTION`. Changing it replaces the permission.

### Optional

- `schema` (String) Name of a schema. When set, the permission applies to that schema; otherwise it applies to the database. Changing it replaces the permission.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The import ID, `database/principal/STATE/PERMISSION`, with `/schema` appended for a schema-level permission.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is database/principal/STATE/PERMISSION for a database-level
# permission, and database/principal/STATE/PERMISSION/schema for a schema-level one.
terraform import conative_azuresql_database_permission.reader_view_definition 'orders/plan-reader/GRANT/VIEW DEFINITION'
terraform import conative_azuresql_database_permission.deny_sales_select 'orders/plan-reader/DENY/SELECT/sales'
```
